HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_CATCHER.title: Soul Catcher
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_CATCHER.description: Whenever your Nail strikes deal damage, gain 11 SOUL. Spells never return SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_CATCHER.flavor: Drawn to the vessel, the essence of fallen foes flows inward.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_EATER.title: Soul Eater
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_EATER.flavor: A charm of darker craving. The vessel hungers, and the void answers.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARPENED_NAIL.title: Sharpened Nail
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARPENED_NAIL.description: The first Nail attack you play each turn strikes 1 additional time.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARPENED_NAIL.flavor: Whetted past any edge the old kingdom knew. It does not cut silence; it removes it.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_VESSEL.title: Soul Vessel
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_VESSEL.description: At the end of your turn, if you have at least 66 SOUL, gain 8 Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_VESSEL.flavor: Distilled vessel-shell, able to hold far more than it should. It hums when full.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAM_TOTEM.title: Dream Totem
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAM_TOTEM.description: The first time you spend SOUL each combat, draw 2 cards.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAM_TOTEM.flavor: It dreams of an older contract. Spend, and the dream widens.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPELL_TWISTER.title: Spell Twister
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPELL_TWISTER.description: Spells (except Focus) cost 24 SOUL instead of 33.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPELL_TWISTER.flavor: A twisted charm that wrings more from less. The well runs deep - just not for the idle.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAILMASTERS_GLORY.title: Nailmaster's Glory
HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAILMASTERS_GLORY.descripti: The first Nail Art you play each turn deals 8 additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAILMASTERS_GLORY.flavor: Three masters bowed to no one. They bowed to the nail.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARP_SHADOW.title: Sharp Shadow
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARP_SHADOW.description: When Shade Cloak phases an attack, deal 9 damage to the attacker.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARP_SHADOW.flavor: Shadows are not empty. They are where the light keeps its knives.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONG.title: Grubsong
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONG.description: Whenever you lose HP, gain 11 SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONG.flavor: It hums a grateful note each time the vessel bleeds. Strange company, warm song.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_HEART.title: Void Heart
HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_HEART.description: At the start of your turn, if you have at least 66 SOUL, gain 1 Energy and lose 33 SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_HEART.flavor: Half of the Kingsoul, whole of the truth. It neither shines nor hums — it simply is.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-AWAKENED_DREAM.title: Awakened Dream
HOLLOWKNIGHT-AWAKENED_DREAM.description: Focus heals 6 more HP. The first time you play Focus each combat, draw 1 card.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-AWAKENED_DREAM.flavor: The dreamer stirs, and forgotten skills surface with it.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPRINTMASTERS_GIFT.title: Sprintmaster's Gift
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPRINTMASTERS_GIFT.descript: The first Skill you play each turn draws 1 card.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPRINTMASTERS_GIFT.flavor: The Sprintmaster never taught standing still - the wind itself was his student.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HIVEBLOOD.title: Hiveblood
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HIVEBLOOD.description: Whenever you lose HP, the next Spell you play this turn costs 1 less Energy.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HIVEBLOOD.flavor: The hive's gift comes with a sting: sweetness brewed from pain, drunk in one gulp.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-LIFEBLOOD_CORE.title: Lifeblood Core
HOLLOWKNIGHT-LIFEBLOOD_CORE.description: Gain 8 Block at the start of each combat. Whenever you lose HP, gain 6 SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-LIFEBLOOD_CORE.flavor: A blue heart still beating, brewing every wound into rushing soul.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONG_EATER.title: Grubsong Eater
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONG_EATER.description: Whenever one of your cards is Exhausted, gain 6 SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONG_EATER.flavor: The grub's song and the catcher's hunger, twined in the dark.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GATHERING_SWARM.title: Gathering Swarm
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GATHERING_SWARM.description: Gold you gain is increased by 25%.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GATHERING_SWARM.flavor: A swarm of tiny companions never lets a single Geo slip away.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAMCATCHER.title: Dreamcatcher
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAMCATCHER.description: Resting at a bench heals an additional 15 HP.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAMCATCHER.flavor: The dreams caught in the net mend the cracks in your shell.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-UNBREAKABLE_HEART.title: Unbreakable Heart
HOLLOWKNIGHT-UNBREAKABLE_HEART.flavor: A heart charm refined until it can never crack.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-QUICK_FOCUS.title: Quick Focus
HOLLOWKNIGHT-QUICK_FOCUS.description: Focus and Deep Focus cost 22 SOUL instead of 33.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-QUICK_FOCUS.flavor: The more practiced the focus, the less SOUL it spends.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SALUBRAS_BLESSING.title: Salubra's Blessing
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SALUBRAS_BLESSING.descripti: At the start of each turn while at FULL HP, gain 22 SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SALUBRAS_BLESSING.flavor: An unharmed vessel hears the blessing of the whispering merchant.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_CANDLE.title: Soul Candle
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_CANDLE.description: At the start of each combat, gain 11 SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_CANDLE.flavor: The flame flickers, and wandering souls follow the light.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_BRAND.title: Void Brand
HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_BRAND.description: At the start of each combat, gain 2 Strength.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-VOID_BRAND.flavor: The abyss's mark is a silent promise.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNEST_SEAL.title: Hallownest Seal
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNEST_SEAL.description: Your Nail attacks deal 3 additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HALLOWNEST_SEAL.flavor: To wear it is to declare: the old glory is not dead.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_CHARM.title: Weavernest Charm
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_CHARM.description: Whenever you summon a companion, add 3 to its current and maximum HP.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_CHARM.flavor: Even the smallest nest shelters a stubborn life.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_BELL.title: Swarm Concord
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_BELL.description: At the start of your turn, if at least two companions are alive, draw 1 card.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_BELL.flavor: A hundred tiny feet move to the same rhythm.
